account_link_challenges_hashes_check.name: account_link_challenges_hashes_check

account_link_challenges_binding_check.name: account_link_challenges_binding_check
account_link_challenges_binding_check.value: ("family_id" is null and "member_id" is null and "channel_link_id" is null and "channel_identity_hash" is null) or ("family_id" is not null and "member_id" is not null and "channel_link_id" is not null and "channel_identity_hash" is not null)

account_link_challenges_state_check.name: account_link_challenges_state_check

account_link_challenges_timing_check.name: account_link_challenges_timing_check
account_link_challenges_timing_check.value: "expires_at" > "created_at" and "expires_at" <= "created_at" + interval '15 minutes' and ("completed_at" is null or ("completed_at" >= "created_at" and "completed_at" < "expires_at")) and ("invalidated_at" is null or "invalidated_at" >= "created_at")

api_request_receipts_member_scope_check.name: api_request_receipts_member_scope_check

consents_subject_ref_check.name: consents_subject_ref_check

consents_subject_deleted_check.name: consents_subject_deleted_check

media_provider_unique_id_channel_check.name: media_provider_unique_id_channel_check
